gloss: relating to or resembling a cone; "conical mountains"; "conelike fruit"

gloss: a country of west central Africa (including islands in the Gulf of Guinea); became independent from Spain in 1968

gloss: one of the evil spirits of traditional Jewish and Christian belief

gloss: a manner that is serious and solemn
meaning: ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಪ್ರಶಾಂತ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಅಥವಾ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾದ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಭಾವ

gloss: a deity worshipped by the Hindus

gloss: hit (a ball) with a racket

gloss: paying particular notice (as to children or helpless people); "his attentiveness to her wishes"; "he spends without heed to the consequences"

gloss: a message that is stated or declared; a communication (oral or written) setting forth particulars or facts etc; "according to his statement he was in London on that day"

gloss: being ten more than one hundred ninety

meaning: ಮುಳ್ಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಒಂದು ಮರದ ಹಣ್ಣಿನ ಸಿಪ್ಪೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು ಮತ್ತು ನುಣುಪಾಗಿರುವುದು

meaning: ಮೇವಾಡ ಪ್ರಾಂತ್ಯದ ವೀರ, ದೇಶಭಕ್ತ, ಸ್ವಾಭೀಮಾನಿ ರಾಜ

meaning: ಇತರರನ್ನು ಅಥವಾ ಇತರರ ಕೆಲಸಗಳನ್ನು, ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಸಹಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವವ

gloss: a woman headmaster

gloss: the inside lower horizontal surface (as of a room or hallway); "they needed rugs to cover the bare floors"

gloss: coming next after the first in position in space or time or degree or magnitude
meaning: ಏಣಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡನೇ ಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ ಅಂಕಿ
